implementation: Same room-specific detail factories are loaded near the player; aerial view starts with zero of 72 room detail groups
Distant room resources are released with a 12-room mobile cache and 18-room desktop cache; nearby rooms are retained
Mobile outdoor instances use spatial batches with identical matrices, colors and geometry
Existing procedural autumn sky baked to a pixel-identical 1536x768 PNG
Game ESM graph bundled and compressed; model and texture data retain lossless validation
Build-time HTTP ETags remove large synchronous hashes on initial model requests
Student preview and gameplay reuse exact measured model normalization
Pointer-lock grant preserves held movement keys
limitations: Browser emulation is not a real-device FPS guarantee. Per-room decorations and original avatar/texture quality are retained.
